title: GET /api/v1/clusters/{cluster}/objects/{name}/history: result
description: The cluster's versions, newest first. A version holds every object, so this is the one history.

saved_by.description: Value. Who saved the version; null for one recorded before that was kept.

saved_at.description: Value. When the version was saved; null where the engine did not say.

comment.description: Text. The comment written with the version; may be empty.

published.description: Value. True for the version the nodes are told to run.

current.description: Value. True for the newest saved version, the one a publish would build on; not the same as published.

published_version.description: Value. The published version number; null where nothing is published or it is unknown.

total.description: Value. How many versions the cluster has.

limit.description: Value. The most this answer lists, as asked or the default.

truncated.description: Value. True where older versions exist than are listed.
